name: digitalk2
description: Swedish annual reports for small limited companies, prepared with your AI.

interface.shortDescription: Swedish annual reports for small limited companies, prepared with your AI.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to DigitalK2, a hosted service for annual reports (årsredovisning) for small Swedish limited companies (aktiebolag, K2). Your AI uploads the SIE file, reviews the figures, reads the tax calculation and INK2, and fills in the report with you in the same guided flow as on the web. Payment, signing and filing with Bolagsverket are always done by you. Sign in with OAuth; no API key needed.
